key.es: Secuencia: ATIS («information Bravo») → autorización de salida (destino, SID, nivel, código) → puesta en marcha y remolque → rodaje con hold short colacionado → line up and wait → cleared for take-off. «Take-off» solo al autorizar o cancelar; si no, «departure». Parar: «cancel take-off» → «holding»; «stop immediately» → «stopping».
key.en: Sequence: ATIS ("information Bravo") → departure clearance (destination, SID, level, code) → start-up and pushback → taxi with hold short read back → line up and wait → cleared for take-off. "Take-off" only when clearing or cancelling; otherwise "departure". Stopping: "cancel take-off" → "holding"; "stop immediately" → "stopping".

points.es: Escuchar el ATIS y decir su letra al llamar («information Bravo»).
points.en: Listen to the ATIS and quote its letter when calling ("information Bravo").

points.es: Autorización de salida: destino, SID, nivel inicial, código SSR; se colaciona; no autoriza a entrar en pista ni a despegar.
points.en: Departure clearance: destination, SID, initial level, SSR code; read back; does not authorise entering the runway or take-off.

points.es: Rodaje: ruta y hold short colacionados; ante la duda, parar y preguntar.
points.en: Taxi: route and hold short read back; when in doubt, stop and ask.

points.es: «Take-off» solo en «cleared for take-off» y «cancel take-off»; en lo demás, «departure».
points.en: "Take-off" only in "cleared for take-off" and "cancel take-off"; otherwise "departure".

key.es: Niveles: climb/descend flight level o altitude (con QNH), maintain, stop climb at, report reaching, expedite. Rumbos: turn left/right heading; proceed direct; resume own navigation. Velocidades: se mantienen hasta cancelarlas. Espera: punto, rumbo de acercamiento, virajes y hora. Continue approach no es cleared to land. Go around → going around. TCAS RA: seguirlo, «TCAS RA», «clear of conflict, returning to…».
key.en: Levels: climb/descend flight level or altitude (with QNH), maintain, stop climb at, report reaching, expedite. Headings: turn left/right heading; proceed direct; resume own navigation. Speeds: kept until cancelled. Hold: fix, inbound track, turns and time. Continue approach is not cleared to land. Go around → going around. TCAS RA: follow it, "TCAS RA", "clear of conflict, returning to…".

points.es: Niveles: climb/descend flight level…, altitude… QNH…; maintain; stop climb at; report reaching; expedite.
points.en: Levels: climb/descend flight level…, altitude… QNH…; maintain; stop climb at; report reaching; expedite.

points.es: Rumbos y rutas: turn left/right heading, continue present heading, proceed direct, resume own navigation.
points.en: Headings and routes: turn left/right heading, continue present heading, proceed direct, resume own navigation.

points.es: Velocidades: reduce speed to…, maintain… or greater; vigentes hasta «no speed restriction».
points.en: Speeds: reduce speed to…, maintain… or greater; in force until "no speed restriction".

points.es: Espera: punto, rumbo de acercamiento, sentido de virajes, expect further clearance at…
points.en: Hold: fix, inbound track, direction of turns, expect further clearance at…

points.es: «Continue approach» ≠ «cleared to land». Go around → «going around».
points.en: "Continue approach" ≠ "cleared to land". Go around → "going around".

points.es: TCAS RA: seguirlo aunque contradiga al control; «TCAS RA»; al terminar, «clear of conflict, returning to…».
points.en: TCAS RA: follow it even against ATC; "TCAS RA"; when over, "clear of conflict, returning to…".

key.es: Lenguaje claro: frases cortas, sencillas, una idea, números normalizados, comprobar que se entiende; emergencias inequívocas. CPDLC complementa a la voz; respuestas WILCO, UNABLE, STANDBY, ROGER, AFFIRM, NEGATIVE. Competencia lingüística: escala OACI de 6 niveles, mínimo 4; nota = la más baja de seis aspectos. Validez UE: nivel 4 cada 4 años, nivel 5 cada 6, nivel 6 sin reevaluación.
key.en: Plain language: short, simple sentences, one idea, standard numbers, check understanding; unambiguous emergencies. CPDLC complements voice; responses WILCO, UNABLE, STANDBY, ROGER, AFFIRM, NEGATIVE. Language proficiency: ICAO 6-level scale, minimum 4; rating = lowest of six areas. EU validity: Level 4 every 4 years, Level 5 every 6, Level 6 no re-evaluation.

points.es: Lenguaje claro: corto, sencillo, una idea por frase, sin jerga; comprobar la comprensión.
points.en: Plain language: short, simple, one idea per sentence, no slang; check understanding.

points.es: Emergencias: siempre MAYDAY o PAN PAN, nunca rodeos.
points.en: Emergencies: always MAYDAY or PAN PAN, never vague wording.

points.es: CPDLC: mensajes de texto normalizados; respuestas WILCO, UNABLE, STANDBY, ROGER, AFFIRM, NEGATIVE; complementa a la voz.
points.en: CPDLC: standard text messages; responses WILCO, UNABLE, STANDBY, ROGER, AFFIRM, NEGATIVE; complements voice.

points.es: Escala OACI: 1 preelemental, 2 elemental, 3 preoperacional, 4 operacional (mínimo), 5 avanzado, 6 experto.
points.en: ICAO scale: 1 pre-elementary, 2 elementary, 3 pre-operational, 4 operational (minimum), 5 extended, 6 expert.

points.es: Seis aspectos: pronunciación, estructura, vocabulario, fluidez, comprensión, interacción; el nivel es el más bajo.
points.en: Six areas: pronunciation, structure, vocabulary, fluency, comprehension, interactions; the level is the lowest.

points.es: Validez UE (FCL.055): nivel 4 cada 4 años, nivel 5 cada 6, nivel 6 sin reevaluación (OACI recomienda 3 y 6).
points.en: EU validity (FCL.055): Level 4 every 4 years, Level 5 every 6, Level 6 none (ICAO recommends 3 and 6).
